# jobrunner

Small job runner with a pluggable retry policy.

## Retry policy

`run_job` makes up to `RetryConfig::max_attempts` calls, including the
initial call. Only `RetryError::Transient` failures are retried; permanent
failures are returned immediately. Before each retry it asks the injected
`Sleeper` to wait for a delay beginning at `base_delay_ms` and doubling after
each failure. Delays are capped at `max_delay_ms`.

For tests, `FakeSleeper` records requested delays without waiting.
